fact.thing: value after 30 years of $2,850 a month at the MSCI ACWI long-run return
fact.box: a TFSA or RRSP holding a global stock index fund
fact.claim: The MSCI ACWI index of world stocks returned 7.31% a year on average, net returns in US dollars, from Dec 29, 2000 to Oct 30, 2026. If $2,850 a month grew at that rate for 30 years, it would come to about $3.7 million, and only about $1.03 million of that would be money you put in. This is an example, not a promise: returns change from year to year, the index fell 58% from 2007 to 2009, and fund fees, taxes and the CAD/USD exchange rate would change the result.
